name: Precision and Rounding Semantics
description: Rules for rounding modes (Round Half Up, Round Half To Even / Banker's Rounding, Truncation) across Python, SAS, SQL, and JS.
when_to_retrieve: When migrating ROUND() functions between Python, SAS, and SQL
When financial calculations produce 1 cent differences due to tie-breaking strategy
when_not_to_retrieve: When working exclusively with exact integer operations
retrieval_guidance: Python 3 round(2.5) is 2 (round half to even). SAS ROUND(2.5) is 3 (round half away from zero / round half up). SQL ROUND(2.5) in most dialects is 3.
